new_entities.name: Teplizumab in at-risk type 1 diabetes
aliases: anti-CD3 teplizumab for stage 2 type 1 diabetes
teplizumab in relatives at high risk for type 1 diabetes
new_entities.description: Use of teplizumab in antibody-positive individuals at high risk of progressing from stage 2 to clinical stage 3 type 1 diabetes.

new_entities.name: Delay in disease onset
new_entities.description: A longer time to the onset of clinically overt disease compared with placebo or no treatment.

edges.effect_quant: Teplizumab delays progression from stage 2 to clinical type 1 diabetes in high-risk relatives. The pivotal TrialNet prevention trial showed a hazard ratio of 0.41 and extended median time to diagnosis from 24.4 to 48.4 months; longer follow-up preserved the signal, with median times to diagnosis of 59.6 versus 27.1 months and 50% versus 22% remaining diabetes-free.
edges.population: antibody-positive relatives of patients with type 1 diabetes at high risk for progression to clinical disease, corresponding to stage 2 type 1 diabetes
edges.mechanism: Teplizumab modulates pathogenic T-cell responses through anti-CD3 signaling, reducing autoimmune beta-cell destruction and thereby slowing progression to insulin-dependent clinical disease.
edges.summary: This is a clear protective edge. Teplizumab is one of the strongest examples in the track of a disease-modifying therapy that meaningfully changes the time course of progression rather than only treating a downstream manifestation.
edges.caveats: The evidence base is built largely around one pivotal prevention trial with follow-up analyses rather than many independent phase 3 prevention trials. Benefit also appears heterogeneous across immunologic and genetic subgroups.

evidence.citation: HeroldKC et al 2019 N Engl J Med
evidence.notes: An Anti-CD3 Antibody, Teplizumab, in Relatives at Risk for Type 1 Diabetes.

effect_quant.comparator: diagnosis of clinical type 1 diabetes with teplizumab versus placebo in high-risk relatives

evidence.citation: SimsEK et al 2021 Sci Transl Med
evidence.notes: Teplizumab improves and stabilizes beta cell function in antibody-positive high-risk individuals.

effect_quant.comparator: extended-follow-up hazard ratio for development of type 1 diabetes with teplizumab versus placebo in high-risk individuals
